description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc class and related factory functions for IPC communication in the Rialto client, handling media key system support queries and version retrieval.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
classes.description: Implements IPC communication for media key capabilities, including querying supported key systems and their versions.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing instances of MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a shared instance of MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Constructor that attaches to the IPC channel.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Destructor that detaches from the IPC channel.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stub for communication over the IPC channel.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Queries the supported key systems via IPC.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported via IPC.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system via IPC.
